description: Python script for downloading and repacking GitHub archive tarballs, with classes for handling paths, caching commit timestamps, and performing the download process including hash verification and submodule checks.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubError
classes.description: Custom exception for GitHub download errors.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Context manager class for directory and tarball handling, including creation, cleanup, extraction, and packing.

classes.name: GitHubCommitTsCache
classes.description: Cache class for storing and retrieving GitHub commit timestamps to avoid repeated API calls.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubTarball
classes.description: Main class for downloading, verifying, and repacking GitHub tarball archives, supporting hash verification and submodule checks.

methods.name: Path.__init__
methods.description: Initialize Path object with directory path and options.

methods.name: Path.__enter__
methods.description: Prepare directory on context entry, cleaning if preclean is set.

methods.name: Path.__exit__
methods.description: Cleanup directory on context exit unless keep is True.

methods.name: Path.mkdir_all
methods.description: Create directory and parent directories (like 'mkdir -p').

methods.name: Path._rmdir_dir
methods.description: Remove directory and its contents.

methods.name: Path._mkdir
methods.description: Create a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: Path._rmdir
methods.description: Remove a directory if it exists.

methods.name: Path._remove
methods.description: Remove a file or symlink if it exists.

methods.name: Path._listdir
methods.description: List directory contents.

methods.name: Path._os_func
methods.description: Call OS function with error handling for idempotency.

methods.name: Path.rm_all
methods.description: Recursively remove a file or directory.

methods.name: Path.untar
methods.description: Extract tarball into a directory, expecting a single subdirectory.

methods.name: Path.tar
methods.description: Create a tarball from a directory or subdirectory with optional timestamp.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache.get
methods.description: Retrieve cached commit timestamp for a key.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache.set
methods.description: Store commit timestamp for a key.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache._cache_init
methods.description: Initialize cache from file.

methods.name: GitHubCommitTsCache._cache_flush
methods.description: Write cache to file.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball.download
methods.description: Download and repackage GitHub archive tarball, verifying hash and handling submodules.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._has_submodule
methods.description: Check if directory has submodules.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_owner_repo
methods.description: Extract owner and repo from URL.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_hasher
methods.description: Initialize hash object based on expected hash length.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._hash_check
methods.description: Verify downloaded file hash.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_commit_ts
methods.description: Fetch commit timestamp from GitHub API.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._init_commit_ts_remote_get
methods.description: Make API request to get commit date.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._fetch
methods.description: Download tarball from GitHub.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._make_repo_url_path
methods.description: Construct GitHub API URL.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._make_request
methods.description: Make HTTPS request to GitHub API.

methods.name: DownloadGitHubTarball._error
methods.description: Create error object with message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parse arguments and execute download process.
